articles.title: Convergence 数字效果器 DSP 引擎解析
articles.title_en: Inside Convergence: The DSP Engine Explained
articles.summary: 探索 Convergence 多模式数字效果器背后的 SpinFV1 引擎，它如何在小巧的 6HP 体积中实现 23 种效果。
articles.summary_en: Explore the SpinFV1 engine behind the Convergence digital effects processor and how it packs 23 effects into a compact 6HP module.
articles.content:
Convergence 是我们目前功能最密集的数字模块——在仅 6HP 的体积里，它塞入了 23 种效果模式。让我们一探它背后的 SpinFV1 DSP 引擎。

核心芯片运行在 48kHz / 24bit 精度下，所有效果算法都在这个采样率上以零延迟方式处理。立体声输入被同时送入 DSP 的两个处理通道，允许并行处理或串联路由。

23 种效果覆盖了常见的调制类（合唱、镶边、相位）、空间类（混响、延迟、回声）、滤波类以及一系列实验性效果。其中延迟效果特别支持外部时钟同步，让节奏调制与模块系统无缝联动。

完整效果列表、参数说明和固件更新方法，请前往 支持页面 查阅用户手册。
articles.content_en:
Convergence is our most feature-dense digital module to date — packing 23 effect modes into a mere 6HP. Let's take a look at the SpinFV1 DSP engine that powers it.

The core chip runs at 48kHz / 24bit precision, with all effect algorithms processed at this sample rate with zero latency. Stereo inputs are fed into two parallel DSP channels, enabling either independent processing or serial routing.

The 23 effects cover modulation types (chorus, flanger, phaser), spatial types (reverb, delay, echo), filter effects, and a range of experimental effects. Delay effects in particular support external clock sync, allowing rhythm modulation to seamlessly integrate with your modular system.

For the full effect list, parameter descriptions, and firmware updates, please visit the support page for the user manual.

articles.title: Manifold 固件 v1.1 正式发布
articles.summary: Manifold v1.1 正式固件发布，新增菜单设置界面、时钟模块、编码器倍率与工厂预设路由系统。
articles.summary_en: Manifold v1.1 official firmware released, adding a setup menu, clock module, encoder ratio, and factory preset routing system.
articles.content:
Manifold 多模式调制器发布 v1.1 正式固件，是一次功能与体验双方面的大版本升级。

本次更新新增了完整的菜单设置界面，用户可在模块上直接配置默认路由、量化音阶、编码器倍率等参数；新增时钟模块并显示拍号，让节奏类模块的同步更直观；编码器新增 0.25 / 0.5 倍率，让精调体验更细腻。

同时完善了工厂预设路由系统——12 个模块统一增加默认路由至 gate1 / cv1，并修复了设置菜单未保存时参数依然生效的问题，确保模块行为可预测。

固件文件已上传至 支持页面，通过 USB 直接刷入即可升级。
articles.content_en:
The Manifold multimode modulator gets its v1.1 official firmware release — a major upgrade in both features and experience.

This update adds a complete setup menu, allowing users to configure default routing, quantization scales, and encoder ratios directly on the module; adds a clock module with beat indicator for more intuitive rhythm module synchronization; and adds 0.25 / 0.5 encoder ratios for finer adjustment.

The factory preset routing system is also refined — 12 modules now share a default route to gate1 / cv1, and a bug where unsaved settings still took effect has been fixed, ensuring predictable module behavior.

Firmware files are available on the support page, flashable directly via USB.

articles.title: Convergence 固件 v2.0 正式发布
articles.summary: Convergence v2.0 固件正式发布，23 种效果完整适配 SpinFV1 引擎，支持时钟同步延迟与立体声处理。
articles.summary_en: Convergence v2.0 firmware officially released, with 23 effects fully adapted to the SpinFV1 engine, supporting clock-synced delay and stereo processing.
articles.content:
Convergence 数字效果器 v2.0 固件正式发布，完成对 SpinFV1 DSP 引擎的完整适配。

本次更新将 23 种效果模式完整适配至 SpinFV1 引擎，覆盖调制类、空间类、滤波类与实验性效果。立体声输入可送入两个并行 DSP 通道，支持独立处理或串联路由；延迟效果支持外部时钟同步，让节奏调制与模块系统无缝联动。

同时优化了编码器交互逻辑——未按下时快速调整数值，按下时精确调整；并增加了倍频延迟降级功能，当超出最大延迟时自动降级以避免溢出。

固件文件已上传至 支持页面。
articles.content_en:
The Convergence digital effects processor v2.0 firmware is officially released, completing full adaptation to the SpinFV1 DSP engine.

This update fully adapts all 23 effect modes to the SpinFV1 engine, covering modulation, spatial, filter, and experimental effects. Stereo input can be fed into two parallel DSP channels, supporting independent processing or serial routing; delay effects support external clock sync for seamless integration with the modular system.

Encoder interaction logic has also been refined — fast value adjustment when not pressed, precise adjustment when pressed; and a frequency-doubled delay degradation feature is added to automatically downgrade when exceeding the maximum delay to prevent overflow.

Firmware files are available on the support page.

articles.title: Modulus8+4 固件 v1.0 发布
articles.summary: Modulus8+4 双轨音序器 v1.0 固件发布，重构代码结构并采用新的中断间隔，修复 USB 不识别问题。
articles.summary_en: Modulus8+4 dual-track sequencer v1.0 firmware released, restructuring code and adopting new interrupt intervals to fix USB non-recognition.
articles.content:
Modulus8+4 双轨音序器模块发布 v1.0 固件。

本次更新重构了整体代码结构，采用新的中断间隔运行，并修复了此前 USB 接口不识别的问题，让模块与上位机的连接更稳定。旋钮读取与 LED 设置逻辑同步上线，配合矩阵模式与分割模式让 8+4 步进的双轨结构发挥最大创意空间。

每个步进旋钮拧到最大时下次触发将输出随机电平，配合音阶量化与根音选择让即兴演奏变得轻松。
articles.content_en:
The Modulus8+4 dual-track sequencer module gets its v1.0 firmware release.

This update restructures the overall code, adopts a new interrupt interval, and fixes the previous USB interface non-recognition issue, making the connection between the module and host more stable. Knob reading and LED setting logic are also introduced, working with matrix and split modes to maximize the creative potential of the 8+4 step dual-track structure.

Each step knob at maximum outputs a random level on the next trigger, and combined with scale quantization and root note selection, improvisation becomes effortless.

articles.title: Quantizer 固件 v1.0 发布
articles.summary: Quantizer 触摸量化器 v1.0 固件发布，完成 lm358 偏置参数校准与琶音/循环录制功能。
articles.summary_en: Quantizer touch quantizer v1.0 firmware released, completing lm358 bias calibration and arpeggio / loop recording features.
articles.content:
Quantizer 触摸量化器模块发布 v1.0 固件。

本次更新完成了基于 lm358 运放的偏置参数计算与校准，前五个八度的相对偏移量得到精确优化；录制精度提升至 1ms / 1kHz 采样率。同时完成了按下琶音、循环录制、模式密码切换等核心功能，并优化了量化器防止输入抖动导致输出抖动（半个半音阈值）。

EEPROM 记录上一次模式与播放头复位功能也已上线，断电后状态可恢复。
articles.content_en:
The Quantizer touch quantizer module gets its v1.0 firmware release.

This update completes the lm358 op-amp bias parameter calculation and calibration, with the relative offsets of the first five octaves precisely optimized. Recording precision is improved to 1ms / 1kHz sample rate. Core features including press-arpeggio, loop recording, and mode-password switching are complete, and the quantizer is optimized to prevent input jitter from causing output jitter (half-semitone threshold).

EEPROM recording of the previous mode and playhead reset are also live, allowing state recovery after power loss.

articles.title: RandomSkip 固件 v2.0 发布
articles.summary: RandomSkip v2.0 重构六大子模式，新增长按重置事件、按钮切换与模式 5/6 实验性扩展。
articles.summary_en: RandomSkip v2.0 restructures six sub-modes, adds long-press reset, button switching, and experimental modes 5 and 6.
articles.content:
RandomSkip 模块发布 v2.0 固件，完成了对内部架构的较大幅度重构。

本次更新将原有的六个子模式完整移植到新架构下并完成验证；新增按钮切换与 LED 显示逻辑，配合每个模式的独立初始化方法，避免模式间状态串扰。同时新增长按重置事件，让现场即兴演奏中可以快速复位当前轨道。

另外引入了模式 5、模式 6 等实验性扩展，为追求变化的用户提供更多创意空间。
articles.content_en:
The RandomSkip module gets its v2.0 firmware release, completing a substantial restructuring of the internal architecture.

This update ports the original six sub-modes to the new architecture with full verification; adds button switching and LED display logic, and per-mode independent initialization methods to prevent state bleed between modes. A long-press reset event is also added for quick track reset during live improvisation.

Experimental extensions such as mode 5 and mode 6 are introduced, offering more creative space for users seeking variation.

articles.title: RandomSkip 固件 v1.0 发布
articles.summary: RandomSkip 概率/门信号发生器 v1.0 固件发布，新增琶音模式并实现 48kHz 采样率。
articles.summary_en: RandomSkip probability/gate generator v1.0 firmware released, adding arpeggio mode and achieving 48kHz sample rate.
articles.content:
RandomSkip 四通道概率/门信号发生器发布 v1.0 固件。

本次更新完成了最基础版本的稳定输出，并实现了 48kHz 采样率运行，让节奏与概率事件的响应更加精确。同时新增琶音模式，让原本偏向随机触发的模块也能配合外部时钟输出可预期的旋律线条。

各模式之间的切换按钮也已完善，配合 LED 显示让现场操作更直观。
articles.content_en:
The RandomSkip four-channel probability/gate generator gets its v1.0 firmware release.

This update completes the stable output of the base version and achieves 48kHz sample rate operation, making rhythm and probability event responses more precise. An arpeggio mode has also been added, allowing the otherwise random-trigger-focused module to work with external clocks to output predictable melodic lines.

The mode-switching buttons have been refined, and LED indicators make live operation more intuitive.

articles.title: VFAM 固件 v2.1 发布
articles.summary: VFAM v2.1 增加新电路引脚兼容（D5），适配最新硬件修订版。
articles.summary_en: VFAM v2.1 adds compatibility with the new D5 circuit pin, supporting the latest hardware revision.
articles.content:
VFAM 模块发布 v2.1 固件，针对最新硬件修订版进行兼容性升级。

本次更新增加了 D5 新电路引脚的兼容支持，确保新批次硬件在原有同步功能上依旧稳定运行。对老批次硬件完全向后兼容，用户无需担心升级后失效。

固件文件已上传至 支持页面。
articles.content_en:
The VFAM module gets its v2.1 firmware release, with a compatibility upgrade for the latest hardware revision.

This update adds compatibility for the new D5 circuit pin, ensuring that new-batch hardware continues to run synchronization functions stably. It is fully backward compatible with older hardware batches, so users need not worry about post-upgrade failures.

Firmware files are available on the support page.

articles.title: VFAM 固件 v2.0 发布
articles.summary: VFAM 同步器 v2.0 固件发布，新增版本号日志以便快速检查当前固件版本。
articles.summary_en: VFAM sync module v2.0 firmware released, adding version-number logging for quick firmware identification.
articles.content:
VFAM（MOOG DFAM 专用同步器）模块发布 v2.0 固件。

本次更新主要新增了版本号日志输出功能，用户在排查问题或验证设备时可通过日志快速确认当前固件版本；同时优化了开机灯闪烁提示，让模块上电状态一目了然。

固件文件已上传至 支持页面。
articles.content_en:
The VFAM (MOOG DFAM dedicated sync) module gets its v2.0 firmware release.

This update primarily adds version-number log output, allowing users to quickly confirm the current firmware version during troubleshooting or device verification. The power-on LED flash indicator has also been optimized for clearer module status at a glance.

Firmware files are available on the support page.

articles.title: CV2MIDI 固件 v2.2 发布
articles.summary: CV2MIDI v2.2 引入通道与 ID 区分机制，新增 0 排除功能与统一关闭音符能力，并提供 LGT 兼容版本。
articles.summary_en: CV2MIDI v2.2 introduces channel and ID differentiation, adds zero-exclusion and unified note-off, plus an LGT-compatible variant.
articles.content:
CV2MIDI 模块再次升级，v2.2 固件进一步完善了多通道场景下的控制精度。

本次更新引入了通道与 ID 区分机制，可对不同外部设备发送独立的控制信息；新增 0 排除功能避免无意义的零值发送；并支持统一关闭音符，让多通道场景下的停止操作更简洁（暂不支持跨通道批量关闭）。

此外还提供 LGT 兼容版本，覆盖更多硬件分支。
articles.content_en:
The CV2MIDI module gets another upgrade, with v2.2 firmware further refining control precision in multi-channel scenarios.

This update introduces a channel and ID differentiation mechanism that sends independent control information to different external devices, adds a zero-exclusion feature to prevent meaningless zero-value transmissions, and supports unified note-off for cleaner stop operations in multi-channel setups (cross-channel batch off not yet supported).

An LGT-compatible variant is also provided to cover additional hardware branches.

articles.title: CV2MIDI 固件 v2.1 发布
articles.summary: CV2MIDI 模块迎来 v2.1 固件升级，新增多复音版本，修复 CC 控制信息发送错误。
articles.summary_en: CV2MIDI module gets v2.1 firmware with polyphonic support and a fix for CC control message transmission.
articles.content:
CV2MIDI 模块本次迎来 v2.1 固件升级，重点提升了多通道复音能力。

本次更新新增多复音版本，可同时发送多个音符事件，让外部合成器接收更丰富的演奏信息；同时修复了此前 CC 控制信息发送错误的问题，参数控制响应更加稳定。

用户可通过配置助手查看与编辑映射关系，固件文件已上传至 支持页面。
articles.content_en:
The CV2MIDI module receives its v2.1 firmware upgrade, focusing on multi-channel polyphonic capability.

This update introduces a polyphonic version capable of sending multiple note events simultaneously, enabling richer performance information for external synthesizers. It also fixes a previous CC control message transmission error, ensuring more stable parameter control response.

Users can view and edit mappings via the configuration helper. Firmware files are available on the support page.

articles.title: Manifold 固件 v1.0 正式发布
articles.summary: 经过数月的内测与迭代，Manifold 多模式调制器终于迎来了首个正式固件版本，支持全部 16 个内置模块。
articles.summary_en: After months of beta testing, the Manifold multimode modulator gets its first official firmware with all 16 built-in modules.
articles.content:
经过数月的内测与迭代，Manifold 多模式调制器终于迎来了首个正式固件版本 v1.0。

本次更新包含全部 16 个内置模块的完整支持：LFO、EG、CLKDIV、Logic、SNH、RNDOM、SEQ、Eucld、ARP、Beati、MIX、FADER、VCA、Invert、Qunt、OVERFL。每个模块都经过了细致的参数调优，确保在不同工作流中都能稳定发挥。

同时，我们重写了模块间的路由引擎，让信号传递的延迟进一步降低。用户现在可以自由地在任意模块之间建立连接，实现真正灵活的调制网络。

固件文件已上传至 支持页面，通过 USB 直接刷入即可升级。
articles.content_en:
After months of beta testing and iterations, the Manifold multimode modulator has finally received its first official firmware v1.0.

This release includes full support for all 16 built-in modules: LFO, EG, CLKDIV, Logic, SNH, RNDOM, SEQ, Eucld, ARP, Beati, MIX, FADER, VCA, Invert, Qunt, and OVERFL. Each module has been carefully tuned to perform reliably across different workflows.

We also rewrote the routing engine between modules, further reducing signal routing latency. Users can now freely establish connections between any modules to create truly flexible modulation networks.

Firmware files are available on the support page and can be flashed directly via USB.

articles.title: MIDI2CV MK2 固件 v4.1 发布
articles.summary: MIDI2CV MK2 v4.1 固件发布，在 v4.0 双通道架构上优化 3xCV 输出波纹，引入快速 PWM 与线性随机长度计算。
articles.summary_en: MIDI2CV MK2 v4.1 firmware released, refining 3xCV output ripple over the v4.0 dual-channel architecture with fast PWM and linear random-length calculation.
articles.content:
MIDI2CV MK2 模块发布 v4.1 固件，延续 v4.0 的双通道（ch1/ch2）+ 3xCV（vel1/vel2/mod）架构。

本次更新在 v4.0 基础上重点降低了 3xCV 输出的波纹，让控制电压更稳定；引入快速 PWM 方法提升模拟输出精度；并将随机长度的计算方式改为线性，使随机触发更可预测。同时整理了说明文档。

固件文件与升级说明已上传至 支持页面。
articles.content_en:
The MIDI2CV MK2 module gets its v4.1 firmware release, continuing the v4.0 dual-channel (ch1/ch2) + 3xCV (vel1/vel2/mod) architecture.

This update focuses on reducing 3xCV output ripple over v4.0 for more stable control voltage, introduces a fast PWM method to improve analog output precision, and switches random-length calculation to linear for more predictable random triggering. Documentation has also been refined.

Firmware files and upgrade instructions are available on the support page.

articles.title: MIDI2CV MK2 固件 v4.2 发布
articles.summary: MIDI2CV MK2 v4.2 重构为四模式架构，新增时钟分频、播控同步、调谐功能，修复多通道监听问题。
articles.summary_en: MIDI2CV MK2 v4.2 restructures into a four-mode architecture, adding clock division, transport sync, and tuning, with multi-channel listening fixes.
articles.content:
MIDI2CV MK2 模块发布 v4.2 固件，完成从双通道架构向四模式版本的较大幅度重构。

本次更新引入四模式架构，新增时钟分频与播控（播放控制）同步能力；增加调谐功能与两个额外 gate 模式；提升音符处理优先级，并在停止（播控）事件时停止发送时钟。同时修复了 mode=1 与 D8 跳线帽状态下未监听 3/4 通道、mod 无法输出等问题，整理代码结构并移除了内部音序器预留。

固件文件与升级说明已上传至 支持页面。
articles.content_en:
The MIDI2CV MK2 module gets its v4.2 firmware release, completing a substantial restructure from the dual-channel architecture into a four-mode version.

This update introduces a four-mode architecture with clock division and transport (playback-control) sync; adds a tuning function and two extra gate modes; raises note-processing priority; and stops sending clock on transport-stop events. It also fixes issues where mode=1 or the D8 jumper state failed to listen on channels 3/4 and where mod output failed, restructures the code, and removes the internal sequencer reservation.

Firmware files and upgrade instructions are available on the support page.
